description: Calm Magic Readiness & Maturity Scoring Engine

maxWeightedScorePerAxis.formula: (inner_tiles * inner_weight * max_scale) + (stretch_tiles * stretch_weight * max_scale) + (edge_tiles * edge_weight * max_scale)

breakdown.note: threePoint answers are normalized: 1→1, 2→3, 3→5 before weighting

personalReadiness.formula: (sum of (answer_score * zone_weight) for all 64 tiles, personal axis) / 480 * 100
personalReadiness.label: Personal Readiness

organizationalMaturity.formula: (sum of (answer_score * zone_weight) for all 64 tiles, organizational axis) / 480 * 100
organizationalMaturity.label: Organizational Maturity

overallReadiness.formula: average of all 5 season composite scores
overallReadiness.label: Overall Calm Magic Readiness

ranges.label: Org Ahead of Person
ranges.signal: The organization has built infrastructure the person hasn't yet internalized. Risk: systems without embodied intelligence. Recommendation: personal integration work before AI deployment.

ranges.label: Slight Org Lead
ranges.signal: Healthy tension. The organization is pulling the person forward. Good conditions for structured learning and co-creation.

ranges.label: Aligned
ranges.signal: Personal readiness and organizational maturity are in sync. Ideal entry point for introducing relational AI systems. High integration potential.

ranges.label: Slight Personal Lead
ranges.signal: The person is ahead of the organization. Risk: visionary isolation. Recommendation: change management, culture seeding, and team development before scaling AI.

ranges.label: Person Far Ahead of Org
ranges.signal: Strong personal clarity but the organizational container can't hold it yet. The person risks burnout or departure. Recommendation: build the org foundation first — AI will amplify the gap if introduced now.

zoneScores.description: Sub-scores can also be computed per zone to identify where readiness is highest/lowest
zoneScores.innerCore: Sum of 4 inner tile scores (each weighted ×3) / 60 * 100
zoneScores.stretch: Sum of 24 stretch tile scores (each weighted ×2) / 240 * 100
zoneScores.edge: Sum of 36 edge tile scores (each weighted ×1) / 180 * 100

javascriptPseudocode.normalize: function normalize(answer, type) { if (type === 'threePoint') return [1,3,5][answer-1]; return answer; }
javascriptPseudocode.scoreAxis: function scoreAxis(tiles, axis) { return tiles.reduce((sum, tile) => { const w = {inner:3,stretch:2,edge:1}[tile.zone]; const raw = normalize(tile.answers[axis], tile[axis].type); return sum + raw * w; }, 0); }
javascriptPseudocode.compute: function compute(tiles) { const p = scoreAxis(tiles, 'personal') / 480 * 100; const o = scoreAxis(tiles, 'organizational') / 480 * 100; return { personal: p, organizational: o, gap: o - p, composite: (p+o)/2 }; }
